note: One REAL drawing per terrain symbol, cut from the standard's own vector source. The DGIWG Symbol Register publishes a concept-to-symbol index (data/symbology/dgiwg_concepts.json); every register entry is mapped to the SO_#### the register PUBLISHES for the feature's concept, never a symbol that merely looks right. Each SO_#### SVG is rendered with rsvg-convert, so the symbol keeps the register's own colours on a transparent ground. The register is CC BY 2.0. The one non-register entry (quay) is the USGS public-domain vector symbol. AEE does not hand-draw and does not crop a scanned plate.
